name: Confounding Flash
objectiveText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

comments.body:
This quest is a must-complete for all new [b]Gnome Priests[/b], as it teaches you the new racial ability [spell=1277455]. Pick it up from inside the [b]Kharanos[/b] inn and head to Ironforge's [b]Mystic Ward[/b] to your [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=258785/high-priestess-mims#map]class trainer[/url].

Note that the quest description here says to head to Stormwind instead of Ironforge. I recommend going to Ironforge. They likely created multiples of this same quest to start from Elwynn Forest, Dun Morogh and Teldrassil/Darkshore so that you won't miss it even if you leave Dun Morogh before reaching level 10, but I guess we'll have to wait for confirmation there.

At 20, don't forget [spell=1277462].
